campaigns.name: 6-Minute Funnel Fix
campaigns.objective: signups — drive free tier signups from founders needing quick funnel insights before investor meetings.
campaigns.big_idea: Position funnelscope as the fastest path from zero to actionable funnel data for early-stage SaaS founders. Highlight the 6-minute median setup time as a competitive advantage over complex tools like Mixpanel. Use real beta metrics to build credibility.
campaigns.hook: Know where signups drop off before your next investor update.

sample_copy.headline: Your funnel in 6 minutes — no SQL, no tracking plan, no hassle.
sample_copy.body: Founders: stop wrestling with analytics. Install funnelscope, point at your UI, and see where users drop off — all in under 6 minutes. Built for early-stage SaaS teams who need answers fast, not another dashboard full of noise.

assets_needed: Screenshot of first funnel built in <6 min
campaigns.success_metric: Number of new free-tier signups during campaign week
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses plainspoken, founder-friendly tone and emphasizes speed and simplicity, directly reflecting the APP_PROFILE voice and Plausible-like clarity from BRAND_DNA.

campaigns.name: EU-First Analytics
campaigns.objective: awareness — establish funnelscope as the default analytics choice for EU-based startups concerned with GDPR.
campaigns.big_idea: Leverage the default EU data residency as a core differentiator. Target technical founders in Europe who want compliance without negotiation. Contrast with Mixpanel/Amplitude where GDPR features are enterprise-only.
campaigns.hook: Analytics that respects GDPR by default — not as a $50k add-on.

sample_copy.headline: Built in the EU, for the EU: analytics that just works with GDPR.
sample_copy.body: No cookie banners. No data transfers. All events processed and stored in Frankfurt. If you're a founder in Europe, why trust your funnel data to a US-based vendor? funnelscope gives you clarity without compliance risk.
sample_copy.cta: See how it works (no PII collected)

assets_needed: Infographic: data flow diagram (client → EU server)
LinkedIn post series on GDPR pain points
Pitch email to EU-focused SaaS newsletters
campaigns.success_metric: Number of newsletter signups from EU domains
campaigns.why_on_brand: Focuses on ethical data handling and transparency, aligning with Plausible's privacy-first messaging and avoiding enterprise jargon as per dos_and_donts.

campaigns.name: No Data Engineer Needed
campaigns.objective: community — build community trust by showing how non-experts can use funnelscope effectively.
campaigns.big_idea: Celebrate the solo founder who ships fast. Create relatable content showing how to answer key product questions without a data team. Use point-and-click funnel building as the hero feature.
campaigns.hook: You don’t need a data engineer to understand your funnel.

sample_copy.headline: Point. Click. Understand. No SQL required.
sample_copy.body: Most analytics tools assume you have a team. We built funnelscope for when it’s just you. Auto-capture every event. Build funnels by clicking on UI elements. Get answers in minutes — not days.
sample_copy.cta: Try it free — no credit card needed

assets_needed: Tweet thread: 'How I found our biggest drop-off in 8 minutes'
campaigns.success_metric: Engagement rate on social posts (likes, shares, replies)
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses short declaratives and second-person address, avoids jargon, and emphasizes simplicity — all core to the brand voice and Plausible's tone_words like 'simple' and 'straightforward'.

campaigns.name: Funnels in the Wild
campaigns.objective: retention — keep beta users engaged by showcasing real use cases from their peers.
campaigns.big_idea: Feature anonymized funnel insights from real beta workspaces (e.g., 'One founder found 70% drop-off at pricing page'). Normalize sharing and learning without exposing sensitive data.
campaigns.hook: What one founder learned about their signup flow in 6 minutes.

sample_copy.headline: Real funnel insights from real founders — no data science degree required.
sample_copy.body: We’re sharing anonymized wins from our beta: where teams found drop-offs, what they changed, and how conversion improved. All using just the free tier. Because better funnels shouldn’t wait for funding.
sample_copy.cta: Read the first case (and submit yours)

campaigns.success_metric: Percentage of active beta users who submit a funnel story
campaigns.why_on_brand: Builds on key_messages like 'Know where signups drop off' and uses plainspoken language, staying true to the founder-friendly, no-jargon voice.
